title: B2CSQLCraft
description: A 1.20.1 minecraft client modpack to play on B2CSQLCraft server
body:
# B2CSQLCraft 

A 1.20.1 Fabric modpack to play on **B2CSQLCraft** server.

## What is this?

This modpack features modern recreations of best biggest and most popular oldschool Minecraft mods like _IC2, BuildCraft, Thaumcraft_.

This modpack aims at performance, vanilla QoL features, stunning visuals and at making a playable core of three greatest modern minecraft mods: **Create**, **Tech Reborn**, **Spectrum**.

## Why is this?

There are a lot of great big mods that go in different directions. This modpack is an attempt to assemble a playable and fun mod set for group of people with multiple interests and requirements in Minecraft gaming.

## Features

- **Hardcore** - You Die, You Lose A Heart!
- **Create** (with Create Big Cannons, Create Craft & Additions, Create Slice and Dice addons).
- **Tech Reborn** for IC2 / GregTech / Mekanism lovers.
- **Spectrum** as most close Thaumcraft magic vanilla-like mod.
- **AE2** for better and bigger storage systems and craft automation.
- **Farmer's Delight** and **Handcrafted** for cosy feeling of survival in cottagecore fashion.
- **Terralith**, **Structory** and **Naturalist** for richer and livelier world.
- **Plasmo voice** for communication.
- Visual enchancement mods: **WATUT**, **Not Enough Animations**, **Visuality**, **Sounds**, **Falling Leaves**, e.t.c.
- Some more cool mods like **Spyglass Astronomy** and **Exposure**.

> P.S.
> Backpacks and plushies _are_ included!
